A zero-knowledge RLN proof authenticates each message while hiding identity and binds it to a polynomial identity commitment. The agent evaluates the epoch polynomial with a private Shamir share; duplicate messages expose two points, enabling reconstruction of the private key and immediate, proof-verifiable collateral slashing. Thus one bond cannot safely finance Sybil identities, whether named ferrous, raven, or vine.
